description: Diagnosis of the 17 basic questions that the Preview declined (eval/basic-questions-preview-results.json, kind no_support). Each was re-run locally against the same index with the real answer pipeline (retrieval, evidence contract, prompt, validator). Production model: Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b. Retest model: openai/gpt-oss-20b, because the 120b model's daily token budget (200,000) and Gemini's daily request limit (20) were used up; 20b answers are a proxy, not Preview results. Quota errors (HTTP 429 / ProvidersUnavailable) are not answer failures and are listed apart.

results.q: Minimum age for a learner's licence
results.detail: 120b over-refused or added an inference claim ('Based on these provisions ...'); the heading of Act sections was fused to sub-section (1) so a faithful quotation of s.4(1) was matched to s.4(2) (twenty years, section 18).
results.after: partial: 20b answered with the s.7 under-18 consent sentence only; the s.4 age claim is accepted by the validator but the model did not always give it

results.q: Requirements for a learner's licence in Telangana
results.detail: 120b answered 'insufficient' although Act s.8 and Telangana Rules 7 and 24 are in the evidence.
results.after: 20b answered with accurate but only loosely relevant claims (test of competence, duplicate fee); not reliable

results.q: How long is a learner's licence valid
results.detail: Faithful quotation of s.14(1) rejected: the heading 'Currency of licences ...' was fused to it, so no sentence matched.
results.after: answered (20b); the recorded 120b output now validates offline

results.detail: Model chose the 'addition of class' sentence (s.11), whose words 'not for the time being disqualified' trip the penalty-term guard. s.9 only says 'such documents as may be prescribed'; the Central Motor Vehicles Rules 1989 are not in the base.

results.q: Procedure for obtaining a driving licence
results.detail: Refusal text over 500 characters failed the schema; the evidence (s.8, s.9, Telangana rules) does not give a complete procedure.

results.q: What happens if I fail the driving test
results.detail: Answerable from Act s.9 (re-appear after seven days; sixty days and a remedial course after three failures). 120b refused; a later attempt cited the wrong evidence id.
results.after: answered (20b), s.9 only, with its proviso

results.q: Add another class of vehicle to a licence
results.detail: s.11 text 'is not for the time being disqualified' is withheld by the penalty-term guard (the eligibility mask covers 'is not disqualified' but not 'not for the time being disqualified').

results.q: Is a driving licence valid in all states
results.detail: s.13 is not among the six retrieved chunks (the question says 'all states', the Act says 'throughout India').

results.q: Grace period after a driving licence expires
results.detail: The evidence has the thirty-day continuation sentence; 120b refused with a reason over 500 characters (schema failure).
results.after: not confirmed: 20b claim was rejected, retry hit quota

results.detail: Claims merged two sentences and a penalty-term guard fired.

results.q: Change address on a driving licence
results.detail: No retrieved passage deals with a change of address (a Central Motor Vehicles Rules provision, not in the base).
s.39 answers it, but its words 'suspended or cancelled' (a registration certificate) trip the licence-action guard.

results.q: Register a new vehicle in Telangana
results.detail: s.39 and s.41 are not among the retrieved chunks; six Telangana rules fill the list.
s.146 is retrieved; 120b over-refused, 20b left out the proviso that the validator requires.
Claims left out an 'except' qualifier and a proviso.

results.q: Certificate of fitness for a transport vehicle
results.detail: India Code amendment markers ('1[Provided further ...]') kept the provisos of s.56(1) fused to their parent sentence, so no faithful set of claims could pass.
results.after: fixed in the validator (faithful claims now validate; unfaithful ones still fail); not confirmed with a live model

results.detail: 120b over-refused although s.129 is retrieved; claims omitted the provisos.
results.after: answered (20b) from s.129 with both provisos and Telangana Rule 437
